title: Check for balanced parentheses in Python - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: Push opening brackets onto a stack; on a closing bracket, check the stack is not empty and its top matches the corresponding opening bracket. The string is balanced only if the stack is empty at the end.

title: Balanced Parentheses - Bradfield CS
snippet: Simply matching bracket counts is not enough to detect improper nesting like '([)]', where counts match but the order is wrong -- the stack-based approach handles this correctly.
